## Security & Repository Hygiene Checklist
- [ ] **No Secrets:** Confirmed no API keys, tokens, credentials, or private keys are staged.
- [ ] **No Personal Emails:** Confirmed no personal emails (`@gmail.com`) are hardcoded.
- [ ] **No Forbidden Tooling Files:** Confirmed no agent/tooling files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.agents/`, `.cursor/`, etc.) are tracked.
- [ ] **No Debug/Temp Artifacts:** Confirmed no `.log`, `report-temp/`, coverage, or temporary files are added.
- [ ] **Clean Gitignore:** Any new temporary directories or secrets are added to `.gitignore`.
